title: Muscle-Up
summary: A pull-up that transitions over the bar or rings into a dip, an advanced skill for pulling and pushing strength.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: pull-up bar or gymnastic rings.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for lats (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.7 for triceps (helper): each working set adds 0.7 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.5 for upper back (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly upper back total.
Library rating 0.4 for chest (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.4 for biceps (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly biceps total.
Library rating 0.3 for traps (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly traps total.

setup.text: Hang with a false grip if you're using rings.
Pull explosively to your lower chest.
Lean forward over the bar and press out of the dip to straight arms.

form_cues.cue: Turn the wrists over the bar
Strict pull-ups to the chest and deep dips come first.

mistakes.text: Chicken-winging one arm over at a time.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
